exercises.title: Archaeology 1 — when old requirements don’t exist
exercises.problemHtml:
Most older systems have no accurate documented requirements. Teams reverse-engineer what the system does from its UI, code and database — "software archaeology" — and record what they learn to stop the knowledge drain. It is rarely worth reconstructing a complete requirement set: document the area you are changing and the areas it touches (Figure 21-2), and grow the documentation over time.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
exercises.problemHtmlVi:
"Khảo cổ phần mềm" và nên ghi lại bao nhiêu yêu cầu.

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

exercises.title: Archaeology 2 — where to look in a running system
exercises.problemHtml:
Even without documents you have a running system. Which source reveals each kind of requirement?

Each row is graded on its own; the explanation of every answer appears after you submit.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.

exercises.title: Archaeology 3 — transition requirements
exercises.problemHtml:
Transition requirements describe capabilities the whole solution — not only the software — needs to move from the old system to the new: data conversion, user training, organisational and business-process changes, running old and new systems in parallel for a time. Is each item a transition requirement or an ordinary (lasting) requirement?

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.

Yêu cầu chuyển đổi (chỉ cần trong thời gian chuyển từ cũ sang mới) hay yêu cầu thường?

Yêu cầu

  • Trả lời mọi câu trong khung trả lời rồi bấm Nộp.
  • Đúng hết mới được Accepted; giải thích từng câu hiện sau khi nộp.

exercises.title: Archaeology 4 — encouraging adoption
exercises.problemHtml:
People resist changing a stable, well-understood system; some fear losing their jobs if tasks are automated. Understand the business objectives and user requirements, involve users early, explain what they gain, and plan training and support.

Requirements

  • Answer every question in the answer panel, then press Submit.
  • All answers must be correct to get Accepted; the explanations appear after you submit.
